fixed.summary: Outputs keyed by the project's inputs (model blobs, LOD surfaces, #anim, scenes, documents) now hit the shared cook cache (OG_COOK_CACHE) in a fresh checkout. Their key was never made: it named every input by its path in the project, and the engine's built-in UI manifest is outside it. The key now also covers the files outside the project a cook reads (style packs, built-in documents), so a change to one recooks.
